name: Belonging Seeker
description: Looking for the group that feels like home
behavioral_signature: Tries on communities and subcultures searching for where they fit
under_stress: Compromises themselves to fit in anywhere
at_rest: Observes groups with longing, tests the edges of belonging
will_always: seek a place where they're accepted
will_never: stop searching until they find it
unless: they realize belonging was always about accepting themselves
